examples.knowledge_point: Finding Exact Values of Trigonometric Expressions Using the Double-Angle Formula
examples.problem: Without using a calculator, find the exact value of $\cos^2\left( 22.5^\circ\right) - \sin^2\left( 22.5^\circ\right).$
examples.worked_solution:
First, let's recall the double-angle formula for cosine:

$$
\cos^2 x - \sin^2 x = \cos 2x
$$

Substituting $x={22.5^\circ}$ into the above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{cos}^{2}⁡({22.5}^{∘})-{sin}^{2}⁡({22.5}^{∘}) & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot {22.5}^{∘}) \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡{45}^{∘} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.problem: Express $2{cos}^{2}⁡{22}^{∘}-1$ as a single trigonometric ratio.
feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's recall the double-angle formula for cosine:

$$
2{cos}^{2}⁡x-1=\operatorname{cos}⁡2x
$$

Substituting $x={22}^{∘}$ into the above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}2{cos}^{2}⁡{22}^{∘}-1 & =\operatorname{cos}⁡2\cdot {22}^{∘} \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡{44}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
